subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

A soldier of the tenth legion leaped into the water as soon as __the ship touches the shore__.

options.text: the ship was touch the shore

solution:
The correct answer is ‘4’ i.e. the ship touched the shore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "the ship touches the shore" **is incorrect because the sentence is describing a past action.
 
• The correct phrase is *"the ship touched the shore*" to match the past tense "leaped."
 
• The correct sentence should read* "A soldier of the tenth legion leaped into the water as soon as the ship touched the shore."*

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *A soldier of the tenth legion leaped into the water as soon as the ship touched the shore.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**, "No substitution required," is incorrect because the original sentence does not match the tense.
 
• **Option 2**, "the ship was touch the shore," is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3**, "the ship touch the shore," is incorrect as it is not in the past tense.
 
• Using the correct verb tense ensures that the sentence is grammatically correct and clear.
